functions.name: PRICE
functions.description: Current price for a commodity, in its native exchange quote.

functions.name: PRICE_IN
functions.description: Current price converted into a chosen unit. CBOT grains quote in cents per bushel; USD/t restates that properly.

parameters.name: eurRate
parameters.description: USD to EUR rate. Required for EUR/t.

functions.name: BASIS
functions.description: Cash price minus futures, both restated into the same unit before subtracting.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Unit your cash price is in: native, USD/bu, USD/t or EUR/t.

parameters.name: eurRate
parameters.description: USD to EUR rate. Required for EUR/t.

functions.name: CONVERT
functions.description: Converts a price you already have between commodity units. No API call.

parameters.name: nativeQuote
parameters.description: A price in the exchange's native quote.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Target unit: native, USD/bu, USD/t or EUR/t.

parameters.name: eurRate
parameters.description: USD to EUR rate. Required for EUR/t.

functions.name: COT
functions.description: Latest CFTC Commitment of Traders figure for a commodity.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: net_position, managed_money_long, managed_money_short, commercials_long, commercials_short or open_interest.

functions.name: COT_DATE
functions.description: Date of the latest COT report held for a commodity.

functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Historical prices as a spilled two-column range: date and close.

functions.name: CONTRACT_TONNES
functions.description: Size of one futures contract in metric tonnes. No API call.

functions.name: LOTS_FOR
functions.description: How many futures lots hedge a given physical quantity. No API call.

functions.name: LOTS_TO_QTY
functions.description: Physical quantity represented by a number of futures lots. No API call.
